name: sulde
description: Codex adapter for Sulde, an extensible agent harness for tools with compatible protocols. Integrates intent supervision, knowledge, memory and constrained lifecycle automation. Source available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use is not granted.

interface.shortDescription: Guard intent and recall Sulde knowledge in every Codex turn.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Sulde's shared core through its host adapter. Maintains an intent contract, supervises observable Skill/MCP/tool actions, recalls knowledge and memory, and includes the runtime for constrained lifecycle automation. Sulde also exposes MCP/CLI interfaces for compatible tools. Source available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use is not granted.
defaultPrompt: Guard my intent and recall relevant Sulde knowledge for this task.
